title: Chapter 1159
text:
Recently, the weather in Guangzhou suddenly changed. I caught a cold a few days ago, and it was getting better. However, there were many things going on at home before the new year, so I didn't have a good rest. Today, my cold got worse, and I had a fever. I felt dizzy, and my back was strained. The soreness was unbearable, and I felt uncomfortable even when lying down. I really wanted to remove my muscles and tendons to iron them. My lungs had always been bad, and whenever my cough got worse, I was worried that my alveoli would explode.

Furthermore, it was really difficult to write a storyline at this stage. According to the outline, the Supercluster Alliance and the World War would be the last in Version 40. After that, I would use a few chapters to finish the Pro League before entering the next version update. This would pave the way for the Calamity of the Supers or the World Tree War. The general direction was quite clear.

However, the problem was that it was very difficult to determine the role of the main character in this current battle. Due to the restrictions of the United Front, there seemed to be very few chances for Beyond Grade A characters to appear. This wasn't good, and the focus of the description would be off. Furthermore, everyone probably wouldn't like to watch a normal galactic battle without the main character's scenes, so there would be limited meaning in writing it. Thus, I was still thinking about the specific writing method. Should I carefully depict the clash between the players and the two factions, write about the battle between different organizations and different guilds, or just focus on Han Xiao's actions and use the battle between the two factions as a background to quickly pass through.

Although the former was more suitable in terms of structure, it was quite bloated. The latter could be reduced to about a hundred thousand to two hundred thousand words so that it could enter the later versions as soon as possible.

Today, I forced myself to write about two thousand words, but the effect wasn't good. I deleted all of them after a glance, so I wanted to take a leave to adjust my state and recuperate.

Brothers, you all know that other than the ten days of rest I had during the 17th National Day, I usually only took a day off. However, this time, I was really sick, and one day really wasn't enough. I had to take another day off. If I was in good condition on the 18th tomorrow, I would definitely write an update. However, if I didn't get better overnight, I would still have to take a break tomorrow. I just didn't know if the hospital would be able to provide transfusions on the weekend tomorrow.

Although I lived a rough life most of the time, I had to take care of my body when I was sick. I hope brothers can understand.
